15. REMOVE ENGINE LEFT MOUNTING BRACKET
Lower the transaxle side, and remove the bolt and engine left
mounting bracket.
Torque: 60 N-m (610 kgf.cm, 44 ft-lbt)
16. RAISE VEHICLE
CAUTION:
Make sure that the vehicle is securely supported.
17. REMOVE CENTER, LH AND RH ENGINE UNDER cov
ERS
18. DRAIN TRANSAXLE OIL
Oil grade: API GL-4 or GL-5
Viscosity: SAE 75W-90
Capacity: 1.9 liters (2.0 US qts, 1.7 Imp. qts)
Torque: 39 N-m (400 kgt-cm, 29 ft,lbf)
19. REMOVE LH ANO RH FRONT DRIVE SHAFTS
(See page SA-18)
20. REMOVE FRONT EXHAUST PIPE
(a) Disconnect the 2 heated oxygen sensors.
Torque: 44 N-m (450 kgf-cm, 33 ft-lbf)
HINT:
At the time of installation, please refer to the following items.
• Before installing the heated oxygen sensor, twist the sen­
sor wire counterclockwise 3 and 1/2 turns.
After installing the heated oxygen sensor, check that the
sensor wire is not twisted. lt it is twisted, remove the
heated oxygen sensor and reinstall it.
(b) Remove the 4 bolts, compression springs and 2 gaskets.
Torque: 43 N-m (440 kgf-cm, 32 ft,lbf)
